column1: # P4-4-E2 (D4): the manifest of the Modbus/TCP content signature's corpus (modules/telemetry/experiments/engine-linux/modbus-sig.zeek),
# for D6's conditions tests/integration/gt_pcap/modbus-signature-conditions.tsv (corpus-members, corpus-sources, corpus-terms, corpus-pins,
# corpus-not-held). Pinned by SHA-256 in pins.env (MODBUS_SIG_CORPUS_SHA256); its labels are labels.tsv beside it (MODBUS_SIG_LABELS_SHA256).
# Members (corpus-members): GT-PCAP's DNP3 captures (gt-pcap/dnp3/dnp3.sha256, rebuilt by D6's dnp3_cases.py), MANIFEST.tsv's and
# extra-captures.tsv's public captures, the corpus as rehearsed on #643, and the additions of P4-4-E2's amendment: thirteen public Zeek traces
# and three synthesized captures. No derived capture is a member: a held-out capture's moved form (moved_sha256) is the run's, not the corpus's.
# Nothing is committed: every public capture is fetched in the run at its pin and checked, and a synthesized one is written in the run by its
# writer and checked. A capture that fails its check is left out, and its rows read "not run".
# Sources and terms (corpus-sources, corpus-terms; D7 confirms):
#   zeek/zeek at v9.0.1 (d6ac56cdb31f3e643d88eb5c7421a31df7d3a520): COPYING, BSD-3-Clause, SHA-256 1f984adb6b5cd93d5035c2a87c2df5f38922649fbea90c7bd79ff321d17333aa
#     installs the traces with its distribution, and names a third-party origin for some: modbus-eit's is Netresec's 4SICS set, and 4SICS-min's
#     is taken to be the same from its name (D7's N1 on bebd8243); pop3/POP3.pcap's is tranalyzer.com, so no POP3 trace is used.
#   cisagov/icsnpp-* at the commits in the URLs: BSD-3-Clause and a NOTICE.txt carrying a US Government notice (DOE contract). SHA-256s:
#   MANIFEST.tsv's and extra-captures.tsv's captures (automayt/ICS-pcap, Wireshark's sample captures, smartgridadsc/IEC61850SecurityDataset):
#     no stated terms, so fetched at their pins and never committed (corpus-terms; D7's N2 on bebd8243). They bring IEC 104 and MMS.
#   GT-PCAP and the synthesized captures are the project's own (LICENSE.md). Nothing is from a site of the owner's or of this project, or from a
#   network either operates; where each public trace was recorded is not stated per file, and modbus.pcap's origin is unknown, as MANIFEST says.
#   url          a pinned URL, or writer:<path> for a capture written in the run (D6's dnp3_cases.py; D4's synth_corpus.py).
#   protocol     the application protocol of the capture's flows that are not Modbus/TCP, as its source names it, one name each for
#                corpus-protocols' count; `-` where it has none.
#   modbus       none: by its source, no flow is Modbus/TCP. tcp/502: every TCP flow with an end on 502 is Modbus/TCP, and no other flow is.
#                tcp/15020: synthesized Modbus/TCP served on 15020. rtu: Modbus RTU framing carried in raw TCP, `not-modbus` here (label-not-modbus).
#   server_port  the port the source names for the server, which decides a flow's server when the capture holds no SYN (label-flow).
#   moved_sha256 a tcp/502 capture is moved to 15020 by D6's movedport.py in the run (held-502), and the result must equal this; `-` for none.
#   seen         the earlier runs of S0 (`zeek-modbus-sig`, the signature at 3436c8dc) over the capture (judge-seen): rehearsals 43314221626 and
#                43315465228 on #643. `-`: not run under S0 before the amendment (25e1286b) was committed. The amendment's own rehearsals on #643
#                ran over every capture here, and the counted result lists them by run ID.
# Not held (corpus-not-held): SEL Fast Message and SEL's other binary protocols; Modbus ASCII framing inside raw TCP; C37.118 over TCP beyond
# ICSNPP's three test traces; proprietary engineering-tool protocols (SEL's AcSELerator among them); IEC 61850 MMS beyond Wireshark's one
# sample and Zeek's one request; live capture from a SPAN or TAP port; any station's own traffic; Modbus/TCP from a relay;
# and codes 60h to 7Eh in a server's own reply format (the synthesized flows answer with an exception).
